<section class="legal-page">

<style>
@import url('[https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap](https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap)');

/* =====================================
   FOND ET DÉCORATIONS
===================================== */

html, body, #quarto-content {
  background-color: #F4F0E8 !important;
}

#title-block-header {
  display: none !important;
}

.legal-page {
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  color: #293747;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 35px 22px;
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.legal-page * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* LAVANDE À DROITE */

.lavande-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  right: 15px;
  bottom: 10px;
  width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.28;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* ÉPI DE BLÉ À GAUCHE */

.ble-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  left: 8px;
  bottom: 15px;
  width: 175px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.30;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* =====================================
   EN-TÊTE
===================================== */

.legal-header {
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 38px;
  padding: 26px 12px 10px;
  overflow: visible;
}

.legal-filigrane {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 32%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 215px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.14;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.legal-eyebrow {
  color: #9b784b;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.legal-header h1 {
  color: #26394d;
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 46px);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.legal-header p {
  color: #59636e;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* =====================================
   GRILLE & CARTES DE CONTENU
===================================== */

.legal-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.legal-card {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e5e0d8;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 26px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(38, 57, 77, 0.045);
}

.legal-card-full {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e5e0d8;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 26px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(38, 57, 77, 0.045);
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}

.legal-tag {
  display: block;
  color: #9b784b;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.6px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.legal-icon {
  font-size: 28px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.legal-card h2,
.legal-card-full h2 {
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 23px;
  color: #26394d;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.legal-card p,
.legal-card-full p {
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: #4d5965;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
}

.legal-card p:last-child,
.legal-card-full p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.legal-card ul,
.legal-card-full ul {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  padding-left: 20px;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: #4d5965;
}

.legal-card ul:last-child,
.legal-card-full ul:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.legal-card li,
.legal-card-full li {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.legal-note {
  font-size: 14.5px !important;
  color: #6b7682 !important;
  font-style: italic;
}

.legal-page a {
  color: #9b784b;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.legal-page a:hover {
  color: #26394d;
}

/* =====================================
   ENCART PROPRIÉTÉ INTELLECTUELLE / PARTAGE
===================================== */

.legal-callout {
  background: #fcfaf6;
  border: 1px solid #e5e0d8;
  border-left: 5px solid #b49363;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 26px 28px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}

.legal-callout span {
  display: block;
  color: #9b784b;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.6px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.legal-callout h2 {
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 23px;
  color: #26394d;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.legal-callout p,
.legal-callout ul {
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: #4d5965;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
}

.legal-callout ul {
  padding-left: 20px;
}

.legal-callout p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* =====================================
   BANNIÈRE DE CONTACT / RGPD
===================================== */

.legal-contact {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 20px;
  background: #26394d;
  color: #ffffff;
  padding: 26px 28px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 16px rgba(38, 57, 77, 0.10);
}

.legal-contact-icon {
  font-size: 34px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.legal-contact span {
  display: block;
  font-size: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 1.8px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #d2b17d;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.legal-contact h2 {
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  font-size: 22px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.legal-contact p {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  color: #e3e7eb;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.legal-contact p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.legal-contact a {
  color: #d2b17d;
}

/* =====================================
   FOOTER
===================================== */

.legal-footer {
  text-align: center;
  color: #899098;
  font-size: 15px;
  padding: 26px 10px 10px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* =====================================
   RESPONSIVE
===================================== */

@media (max-width: 750px) {

  .legal-page {
    padding: 25px 14px;
  }

  .legal-filigrane {
    width: 170px;
    top: 30%;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }

  .legal-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .legal-card,
  .legal-card-full,
  .legal-callout,
  .legal-contact {
    padding: 21px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {

  .lavande-filigrane {
    width: 110px;
    right: -12px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.20;
  }

  .ble-filigrane {
    width: 105px;
    left: -15px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.22;
  }

  .legal-contact {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
  }
}

/* =====================================
   IMPRESSION
===================================== */

@media print {

  .lavande-filigrane,
  .ble-filigrane,
  .legal-filigrane {
    display: none !important;
  }

}
</style>

Vos contributions ne sont jamais cédées ni revendues à des tiers.
    </p>
    <p>

Vous disposez à tout moment d’un droit d’accès, de rectification et de suppression des informations vous concernant en écrivant à <a href="mailto:fourbanalgrignan@gmail.com">fourbanalgrignan@gmail.com</a>.
